auction_title: Photographs from the Martin Z. Margulies Foundation Part II
title: Bauhaus I and II
medium: Cologne: Rudolf Kicken Gallery, 1984 and 1985. Two portfolios, each with 10 gelatin silver prints.
description: 1984-1985 Cologne: Rudolf Kicken Gallery, 1984 and 1985. Two portfolios, each with 10 gelatin silver prints. Varying sizes from 4 x 5 in. (10.2 x 12.7 cm) to 13 1/2 x 10 7/8 in. (34.3 x 27.6 cm) Each signed in pencil or ink in the margin or on the verso; two with facsimile signatures (Gyula Pap and Franz Ehrlich) and the portfolio stamp, numbered '31' in an unidentified hand in ink, on the verso. Accompanied by the printed title, plate list, introductions by Suzanne E. Pastor and Wulf Herzogenrath respectively, and colophon numbered 31 in ink. Each enclosed within a sage green cloth clamshell portfolio, housed together in a matching cloth slipcase. Number 31 from an edition of 70 plus 30 artist's proofs.
